description:
You are a Product Manager for TailwindTraders. You have received a CSV file containing 8 new requirements (User Stories and Bugs) from a client stakeholder meeting.

**Your Goal:**
1. Import these work items into the TailwindTraders project from the CSV file located at `C:\Users\Docker\Documents\client_requirements.csv`.
2. Review the import to ensure all fields (Title, Priority, Description, Tags) are mapped correctly.
3. After importing, assign all 5 **User Stories** to the **Sprint 2** iteration.
4. Leave the 3 **Bugs** unassigned (in the backlog/root iteration).

**Context:**
- Use the 'Import Work Items' feature in the Boards > Queries or Work Items view.
- Ensure the work items are saved to the project.
- Do not modify the titles or descriptions during import.

items.title: Add multi-currency support for international checkout
Create admin dashboard for order analytics
Implement real-time inventory sync with warehouse API
Shopping cart total miscalculates with percentage discounts
Product image gallery fails to load on mobile Safari
Search results return duplicate products after re-indexing
